name: blincho
description: Screen break reminders and habits for comfortable computer use

scripts.tauri:dev: npm run build && cargo run --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.tauri:build:mac: npm run build && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/bundle-tauri-macos.cjs
scripts.tauri:test:mac: cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/bundle-tauri-macos.cjs --debug && node tests/tauri-smoke.cjs --bundle-debug --long
scripts.tauri:test:layout: npm run build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node tests/tauri-layout-smoke.cjs
scripts.tauri:build:win: npm run build && tauri build --bundles nsis --ci --no-sign -- --locked
scripts.tauri:build:linux: npm run build && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm --ci --no-sign --no-binary-patching -- --locked
scripts.tauri:test:mcp: npm run build && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node tests/tauri-local-mcp-smoke.cjs

author: Blincho Team
